parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The direction of the traffic to which the access control policy applies.

Valid values:

*   **out**: outbound traffic

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The IP version supported by the access control policy. Valid values:

*   **4**: IPv4 (default)

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and the response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese (default)
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: NatGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-nat-firewall-policy-prior-used --lang zh --nat-gateway-id ngw-xxxxxx --direction out --ip-version 4 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw DescribeNatFirewallPolicyPriorUsed --region cn-hangzhou --IpVersion 4 --Lang zh --NatGatewayId 'ngw-xxxxxx' --Direction out
